reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the terrain in Provincia. With our new native sparse cellular automata, ponds are now more efficient, and the flow map updates seamlessly. This means you can dig, raise, and shape your land without any lag. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

posts: Discover the latest changes to water mechanics in Provincia! Our new system ensures that water depth updates in real-time as you modify the terrain. Learn more about these enhancements here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

Big news for our water systems in Provincia! With the new updates, wells won't freeze the frame anymore, and terrain edits are now more responsive. Dive into the details: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

discord.content: We've rolled out some fantastic updates to the water mechanics in Provincia! The new system allows for smoother interactions and real-time updates as you shape the terrain. No more freezing frames when using wells! For more details, check out our latest devtalk.

steam.title: New Water Mechanics in Provincia!
